description: Angular component for handling multi-factor authentication setup and login, including QR code generation, SMS/Email verification, and backup codes.

classes.name: ForceTwoFactorAuthLoginComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing the UI and logic for multi-factor authentication setup and login, including QR code display, SMS/Email verification, and backup code handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up forms, fetches MFA settings.

methods.name: goBackByType
methods.description: Handles navigation back to previous MFA setup step based on provider type.

methods.name: isAnyProviderAvailable
methods.description: Checks if any MFA provider is available based on current settings.

methods.name: allowedProviders
methods.description: Filters allowed MFA providers based on configuration.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates MFA state and generates configuration for selected provider.

methods.name: tryAnotherWay
methods.description: Resets MFA setup to allow choosing another provider.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Verifies and saves MFA configuration with verification code.

methods.name: updateQRCode
methods.description: Generates QR code for authenticator app setup.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Exports backup codes to a file.
